title: Fake Erasmus Grant
scenario: An email says your Erasmus grant is ready but requires a bank verification fee.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.C: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Fake Erasmus Grant: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Grants do not require fees to release funds.
